a-model-can-learn-from-public-text-alone.header: One model trained only on public datasets
a-model-can-learn-from-public-text-alone.description: The LLaMA authors set out to show that state-of-the-art models could be trained using publicly available datasets exclusively; this describes that model's training, not every model [1].

touvron-llama.title: Touvron et al., LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models

customer-conversations-are-not-training-.header: Anthropic excludes commercial data by default
customer-conversations-are-not-training-.description: Anthropic says it does not use inputs or outputs from its commercial products for training by default. For those products, internal processes, decisions and naming are not automatically part of the model's training data; other providers and settings may differ [1].

anthropic-commercial-training.title: Anthropic, Is my data used for model training? (commercial products)

rare-facts-are-learned-poorly.header: Rare facts can be harder to recall
rare-facts-are-learned-poorly.description: In the studied factual-question benchmarks, answer accuracy tracked how many training documents mentioned a fact. That finding does not mean every rare fact is absent or every model behaves alike [1].

kandpal-long-tail.title: Kandpal et al., Large Language Models Struggle to Learn Long-Tail Knowledge

the-context-must-be-supplied.header: Context can be retrieved at request time
the-context-must-be-supplied.description: Retrieval-augmented generation pairs a model with searchable memory that can be consulted when a request runs. Relevant organisational knowledge can therefore be supplied or retrieved at task time rather than assumed to be in training data [1].

lewis-rag.title: Lewis et al., Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks

speed-not-context.title: Speed, not context
speed-not-context.script: Now give the same four cards to agents. In this thought experiment, each card is ticked much faster, while the handoff gaps remain. That is an illustration, not a measured universal speedup. An agent also cannot reliably use private constraints it cannot access, and the paintball agent never saw the accessible bus.

plausible-guess.title: Plausible guess
plausible-guess.script: When context is missing, an agent may fill the gap with a plausible guess instead of asking. In our food example, no one specified whether eggs were allowed, so the kitchen's interpretation did not fit those guests. The example reaches the same four handoff failures in two minutes instead of two weeks; those timings illustrate the scenario, not a general benchmark.
